---
title: "NY NOAA Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)

data("ny_noaa")
```

```{r prepare_data, include=FALSE}
ny_noaa_2010 = ny_noaa |>
  filter( date >= "2010-01-01", date < "2011-01-01")
```

```{r}
ny_noaa_temperature = ny_noaa_2010 |>
  mutate( tmax = as.numeric(tmax), tmin = as.numeric(tmin)) |>
  drop_na(tmax, tmin) |>
  filter(tmax >= tmin) |>
  mutate( tmax_c = tmax / 10, tmin_c = tmin / 10, month = factor(lubridate::floor_date(date, unit = "month")))
```

```{r}
ny_noaa_precipitation = ny_noaa_2010 |>
  drop_na(prcp) |>
  mutate( month = lubridate::floor_date(date, unit = "month"), prcp_mm = prcp / 10) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(mean_prcp_mm = mean(prcp_mm))
```


Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Minimum vs. Maximum Temperature in January 2010

This scatterplot shows the relationship between daily minimum and maximum temperatures in January 2010. Each point represents a weather station observation. Temperatures are measured in degrees Celsius.

```{r scatterplot}
weather_scatter = ny_noaa_temperature |>
  filter(date < "2010-02-01") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin_c, y = tmax_c)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs( x = "Minimum temperature (C)", y = "Maximum temperature (C)")
ggplotly(weather_scatter, height = 700)
```


Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Maximum Temperature by Month in 2010

These boxplots compare the distribution of daily maximum temperatures across the 12 months of 2010. Temperatures are measured in degrees Celsius.

```{r boxplot}
ny_noaa_temperature |>
  plot_ly( y = ~tmax_c, color = ~month, type = "box", colors = "viridis", height = 300)
```


### Average Daily Precipitation by Month in 2010

This bar chart shows the average daily precipitation across available weather station observations for each month in 2010. Precipitation is measured in millimeters.

```{r barchart}
ny_noaa_precipitation |>
  plot_ly( x = ~month, y = ~mean_prcp_mm, type = "bar", height = 300)
```
